show.name: Айда!
show.summary: Grisha, a teenager from a privileged family, moves from Volgograd to Kazan and finds himself in the epicenter of a street gang war. He is a stranger in this world, but in order to survive, he has to learn its cruel rules. Zakharevich, the ideologue of the Tyap-Lyap gang, becomes an unexpected mentor for him. He is an intelligent, educated and ambitious manipulator who created a system for dragging teenagers into organized crime. The only one who is aware of the impending threat is the head of the criminal investigation department Nikonov. It will take time for him to understand that this is not just a criminal outburst, behind which there are non-ordinary figures, but the beginning of large-scale processes capable of destroying the country.

show.name: История его служанки
show.summary:
Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt.

 Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.

show.name: Красота
show.summary: The end of the 80s, a time of change and high hopes. Vera, the director of the House of Culture, launches the country's first beauty contest, despite the displeasure of officials. But against the background of the collapse of the country, it is under threat of closure — the country has no money for beauty. In an attempt to find a solution, Vera makes a deal with criminals, falling into a dangerous trap.

show.name: Тяжелый люкс
show.summary: Ksenia is the wife of a wealthy real estate developer, living in a world of luxury brands, exclusive clubs, and a constant struggle for status. She desperately tries to fit in among the women of Rublevka, but after a tragic accident, she finds herself drawn into the underground market for elite "pali."

show.name: Murder Down Under: Bad Cop
show.summary: Inside the chilling murders of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies, tracing the police investigation and ex-police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon's bombshell courtroom trial.

show.name: Against the Sky Supreme
show.summary: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

show.name: Cang Yuan Tu
show.summary: The story tells the story of Meng Chuan, the protagonist, who has made a vow to avenge his mother's death since he was a child and takes the Mirror Lake Daoist College as his starting point. With his resolute and fearless heart and decisive sword skills, he punishes the evil, destroys the demons, ascends to the top of the four Daoist Colleges, becomes famous in the Dongning Province, pays homage to the Yuanchu Mountain, and achieves a generation of gods and demons.(DeepL)

show.name: Her Willing Subject
show.summary: Regent Lu Qingcang and Empress Shen Shuying once divided the realm, ruler against ruler—yet the Yin-Yang Gu bound them to a shared fate of life and death. Manipulated by schemers, they perished together. Both reborn, they resume their bitter rivalry. Step by step, through political bloodshed and emotional tug-of-war, they unravel misunderstandings, learn to coexist and love, and join forces to break the game—transforming from hostile rivals into equals in love.

show.name: Francesca Next Door
show.summary: Na Yeong, the vampire transfer student from Romania. Zero social skills, zero common sense, but also zero malice. Although Na Yeong has clear standards and logic, she cannot adapt to the human world and constantly goes astray and causes trouble at school, but upon meeting U Ju, she feels the emotion of a racing heart for the first time. A young vampire who falls in love with a human, and a fellow vampire who stirs her instincts; a sweet yet deadly romance of youths wavering between love and instinct.

show.name: Wintertime
show.summary: Nine years after their last encounter, Koo Seung Hyeok and Kwon I Hyeon unexpectedly reunite at Nexus, a nightclub linked to organized crime. Seung Hyeok, now the club manager, confronts I Hyeon, who works in lowly conditions, leading to a series of hostile interactions rooted in past grievances. When I Hyeon's father is diagnosed with cancer, he reluctantly re-engages with Seung Hyeok under a work and debt agreement. This forced collaboration ignites complex emotions, as hatred and fixation intertwine. As both men grapple with their tumultuous history—Seung Hyeok's contempt and I Hyeon's struggle with vulnerability—they face the choice between continued conflict or an unforeseen future together.

show.name: The Legend of Luoxiaohei
show.summary: The story started from a rainy night, a homeless little black cat was brought home by a young girl Luo Xiaobai, that girl named the cat "Luo Xiaohei". LXH is not an ordinary cat, it can use the closestool well but doesn't eat cat food, its long tail can be splited into multiple organisms call "Heixiu" . On the other hand, a mystery role called "Diting" now is commanding his henchmen three wolfs with wings to search for LXH. When Xiaobai bring LXH to the countryside, she finally found that Xiaohei made her involved in a variety of bizarre fantasy events...

show.name: Fox Spirit Matchmaker
show.summary: Buy UCO from childhood grew up in the clan, Ichigo, but their "care" was for him a living Hell. Constant bullying, stealing the Goodies, without which Ycu can not live, and even eternal persecution, from the fair sex turned him into a goner cheapskate who wants to take revenge on his tormentors. But revenge is sweet and the path to it is thorny and to accomplish, UCU need to marry a girl Yes, as soon as possible. But when the heroes just happen? Never! And meeting with the small and the big-eared Fox Susan su su did not just destroy his plans, but starts spinning the wheel of fate that was waiting in the wings for hundreds of years!

show.name: Silent Echoes
show.summary: In 2011, a murder case occurs at Jiugu Lake in Xiping City. Detective Ma Xuesong and rookie female officer Meng Wen begin investigating and discover the case is linked to the disappearance of Luo Xue, involving multiple parties including the Deli Group. As more murders surface, a criminal network involving drugs, money laundering, and abuse gradually comes to light. Throughout the investigation, the two draw closer to the truth while each undergoes their own growth and trials.

show.name: Blossom in Darkness
show.summary: The play is adapted based on Guoguo's novel of the same name. Big Demon Qi Fengyin (acted by Li Hongyi), born out of evil thoughts, is locked in the Panic Mountain Barrier due to his killing of the mortals and immortals a thousand years ago. The small Medicine Spirit Yamao (acted by Sun Zhenni), transformed from the herb Huanyangcao, is chased by all sorts of people due to its magic physique and happens to break in the barrier, leading Qi Fengyin's failure to have a human body and his evil thoughts fly. Since then, the two have had a deep bond and have experienced all kinds of stories together.

show.name: The Story Untold
show.summary: Adapted from Twentine's novel The Story Untold, the drama follows Yang Zhao, an art restorer haunted by childhood trauma. She has long believed that her emotional wounds will never heal, until she meets Chen Mingsheng, a narcotics officer working undercover in Bai Ji's drug trafficking organization. Their encounter profoundly affects them both, but when his mission goes wrong, Chen Mingsheng is forced to disappear from Yang Zhao's life. Their abruptly interrupted relationship leaves an indelible mark on her heart. Three years later, Yang Zhao unexpectedly reunites with Chen Mingsheng in another city. Having lost a leg, he now lives an unassuming life as a taxi driver. Determined never to let him go again, Yang Zhao finally opens up to him, revealing her true self and allowing him into her world. However, during a trip, Chen Mingsheng's identity is exposed, forcing him to return to the front lines of the fight against drug trafficking. The two promise never to be separated again once his mission is complete. Yet when Yang Zhao finally receives news of Chen Mingsheng, she rushes to the hospital, only to find him fighting for his life. As she watches helplessly, she has no idea what fate has in store for them...

show.name: Taming the Husband
show.summary: Jin Bao Zhu, the spirited daughter of a butcher, has always harbored simple, materialistic dreams of wealth and comfort. Desperate to escape her oppressive family life, she volunteers to enter a prestigious canal transport family as the concubine of their son, Xie Yan. However, her dreams of luxury quickly shatter: while Xie Yan was once a brilliant prodigy, he has been left disabled and disgraced by a tragic accident. Xie Yan has become bitter and self-destructive and resents Bao Zhu, who he feels has been forced upon him. The marriage gets off to a rough start, as Xie Yan and Bao Zhu are constantly fighting. But as they navigate the treacherous political schemes surrounding the canal transport industry and fend off ambitious relatives, their mutual animosity slowly transforms. Can they find a way to work together to save their crumbling family legacy and their marriage?

show.name: Fight for My Way
show.summary: After years of fiercely protecting each other from the sidelines, Hanz and Aira realize that their biggest challenge isn't conquering their dead-end careers, but risking their friendship for a chance at love.

show.name: Daughter of a Concubine
show.summary: The blind girl rises up against the entire family!

body.name: Verdens hardeste maraton
body.summary: 42.2 km of running. With 20,000 (!) steps along the way. Nicolay challenges fitness enthusiast Kasper Kvello to a marathon on the Great Wall of China.

show.name: Helt Ramme sporter
show.summary: From acrobatic football-volleyball in Malaysia to the World Championship in eating fries in Canada. Nicolay Ramm brings four of Norways bravest celebs out in the world. Here they will try to become the best in some of the worlds weridest sports.

show.name: My Chef in Crime
show.summary: Forensic scientist-turned-chef Chan becomes the prime suspect in his rival chef's mysterious death. He must clear his name, using his deep knowledge of food chemistry and forensic science, and teaming up with fearless investigative police officer Lieutenant Lalit whose past intertwines with his own. Together, they tackle intriguing cases through culinary experiments and create mouth-watering dishes.

body.name: Syndebukken
body.summary: The heat is on for several of the participants. Suspicion is growing. Alliances are crumbling. Who will survive and earn another 24 hours at the Bluff Castle?

show.name: Bløff
show.summary: In a fairytale castle, ten contestants compete against each other in a game that isn't about how smart you are, but about how smart people think you are.

body.name: Gone Christmas Fishing 2026
body.summary:
In this Christmas special of Gone Fishing, Paul and Bob travel to North Norfolk to celebrate the end of another unforgettable year of fishing and friendship.

Their first guest is Steve Coogan, who joins them for a drink and a light supper of sardines on toast, and the three old comedy chums chat about their careers, their Christmas traditions and how Steve is preparing to celebrate his first Christmas as a grandad.

The fun continues as Bob introduces an old friend from his neck of the woods in the North East – the music superstar Sam Fender.

Sam tells them about his crazy year at the top of the charts and how much he is looking forward to a peaceful Christmas time with his close family.

The trip culminates in the annual Gone Fishing Awards and an emotional farewell to their beloved canine companion, as they bid Ted a loving farewell and give him his final ‘And Away'...

show.name: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
show.summary: Two friends, beautiful places and a good natter. Bob Mortimer and Paul Whitehouse go on a life-affirming, funny journey, sharing their changed outlooks and trying to land a catch.

body.name: The Mandy Who Knew Too Much
body.summary: Mandy rarely dabbles in global diplomacy, especially over Christmas when it's so cold out and there's good telly on, but when she does, you can bet that she makes a real difference to the balance of power in the world.

show.name: Mandy
show.summary: Mandy is a woman with dreams. Big dreams. Most of all she dreams of breeding Doberman Pinchers. But there are hurdles to overcome before that dream can become a reality.

nextepisode.name: The Mandy Who Knew Too Much

body.name: Dexter Procter and the Case of the Disappearing Doctor
body.summary: Dexter and his friends uncover a dastardly plot involving earthquakes, mysterious maladies and runaway ambulances. Can they outsmart a pair of sinister sisters and save Lilydale?

show.name: Dexter Procter: The 10-Year-Old Doctor
show.summary: Dexter Procter: The 10-Year-Old Doctor tells the story of Dexter Procter, a 10-year-old paediatrician trying to solve – frequently disgusting – medical mysteries, save his job, and find his place in the world.

nextepisode.name: Dexter Procter and the Case of the Disappearing Doctor

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: River of No Return
show.summary: Adapted from the novel of the same name written by Ma Boyong, the story follows crown prince Zhu Zhanji, who is trapped in Nanjing and caught in a shocking conspiracy. Together with constable Wu Dingyuan, female doctor Su Jingxi, and junior official Yu Qian, he dodges layers of manhunt and travels all the way back to the capital via the Grand Canal within 15 days to receive the imperial edict.

show.name: River of No Return
show.summary: Adapted from the novel of the same name written by Ma Boyong, the story follows crown prince Zhu Zhanji, who is trapped in Nanjing and caught in a shocking conspiracy. body.name: The Bride's Chamber
body.summary:
1858. An inn with no name, an eccentric landlord and a lone traveller with a strangely familiar appearance. As he settles into his room for the night, the traveller is visited by an uncanny man in black, with a story to tell…

The Bride's Chamber tells the tale of a spurned and vengeful suitor who manipulates a young woman and marries her to claim her fortune. But his murderous plans create his own purgatory…

show.name: A Ghost Story for Christmas
show.summary: Mark Gatiss, master of the macabre, presents chilling Christmas stories for a cold winter's night.

body.name: Human Interest
body.summary: Here we see that Natalie's return from walking in the spiderwebs isn't the salvation it once seemed, especially for Shauna. With new neighbors, a change in leadership, and the pressures of society all bearing down, you better light your candles.

show.name: Yellowjackets
show.summary: Yellowjackets follows a girls' high school soccer team. In 1975, the Dearborn High Yellowjackets became the first team in state history to qualify for the Girls' U.S. Soccer Championship Series in Manchester, NH. They never got the chance to compete. Equal parts survival epic, horror story and pitch black coming of age, Yellowjackets tells the story of the (un)lucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Ontario wilderness, chronicling their descent from a friendly, cooperative team to warring, cannibalistic clans. At the same time, it follows the lives they've attempted to piece back together nearly twenty-five years later, proving that the past is never really past and what began out in the wilderness is far from over.

body.name: I Learn How to Grow Zombies
body.summary: In the hunt for Annabeth, our quest team finds themselves hunted.

show.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
show.summary: 12-year-old modern demigod Percy Jackson has just come to terms with his newfound supernatural powers when the sky god Zeus accuses him of stealing his master lightning bolt. Now Percy must trek across America to find it and restore order to Olympus.

previousepisode.name: An Old Dead Friend Comes to Visit

nextepisode.name: I Learn How to Grow Zombies

body.name: We Visit the Junkyard of the Gods
body.summary: Lost in the Junkyard of the Gods, the quest team must fight their biggest foe yet.

show.name: Batwheels
show.summary: Bam, Redbird, Bibi, Batwing, and Buff are thrust into hilarious hijinks and draw-dropping action as they learn important lessons about teamwork, friendship, and so much more while helping Batman, Robin, and Batgirl defend Gotham.

show.name: Drag Race Philippines
show.summary: The hit global drag phenomenon is now in the Philippines! Watch as 12 iconic queens slay and race to the finish line and compete to be the first ever Drag Race Superstar from the Philippines. It's the Filipinos' time to shine, henny... and you ain't seen nothing yet!

body.name: Black Diamonds
body.summary: Dwight expands his operation while seeking stronger backing abroad. Mitch and Spencer look to score big at the track.

show.name: Tulsa King
show.summary: Tulsa King follows New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi, just after he is released from prison after 25 years and unceremoniously exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a "crew" from a group of unlikely characters, to help him establish a new criminal empire in a place that, to him, might as well be another planet.

body.name: Denver Broncos at Pittsburgh Steelers
body.summary: Live from Acrisure Stadium Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. At 8:15 p.m. ET.

show.name: Thursday Night Football on Prime Video
Thursday Night Football on Prime Video
show.summary: Thursday Night Football on Prime Video will provide members a unique viewing experience with interactive features that bring fans closer to the game, such as X-Ray and Next Gen Stats powered by AWS. Prime members will also be able to choose from multiple alternative audio options exclusive to Prime Video.

show.name: The Great Ruler
show.summary: In the vast world, planes converge and numerous races thrive. A gathering of extraordinary talents unfolds, where one after another, supreme beings from the lower planes come forth. In this boundless realm, they weave captivating legends that inspire admiration, pursuing the path to dominance.

body.name: The Natural Order of Things
body.summary: Ruby talks art forms & politics. Jarvis unites nerds and jocks. D.J. explains how time go up.

show.name: Smartypants
show.summary: The greatest thinkers/comedians of our time ask the questions no one else will.

show.name: Amanpour
show.summary: Amanpour is CNN International's flagship global affairs interview program hosted by Chief International Correspondent Christiane Amanpour.

body.name: Out of the Past
body.summary: A familiar face from Dexter's past resurfaces, challenging his beliefs and reshaping his next move; as Harrison takes on greater responsibility within the NYPD, the hunt for the Five Borough Killer intensifies across New York.

show.name: Dexter: Resurrection
show.summary: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

show.name: Homestead: The Series
show.summary: A continuation of the movie Homestead... Amid chaos, ex-Green Beret joins prepper compound; love grows, truths arise, and a community unites.

show.name: Furia
show.summary: A contemporary portrait around five women ready to do anything in the face of extreme situations such as extortion, oppression, deceit, exclusion or manipulation in a single shared universe articulated around five conflicts that will develop like a butterfly effect – one as a consequence of the other – and so on to shared catharsis.

show.name: Still a Family
show.summary: In 2008, with China's economy booming, the Sai Duoxi family living on the Jiaodong Peninsula undergoes a dramatic change. A large demolition compensation payment puts the family's old troubles and chronic problems on full display. Sai Duoxi, a domineering and authoritarian father, throws his children's lives into chaos as he fights to preserve his rule over the household. The five pairs of sons and daughters in the Sai family are five different portraits of life. A sudden turn of events then shakes Sai Duoxi's status as "head of the family," while the five pairs of children begin to reconsider the family's generational relationships and confront their own life dilemmas. Ultimately, the Sai family comes to understand that a home is a place of equality and dignity, and that love means family reunion.

show.name: American Pulse
show.summary: American Pulse is an hour showcasing reporting from the vast network of CNN affiliates across the country.

show.name: The Football Interview
show.summary: The biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation's favourite sport.

show.name: Arafta
show.summary: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart. Suspended between love's salvation and fate's cruelty, Arafta is a saga of passion and payback, where every choice risks turning fire into ashes.

show.name: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
show.summary: America, 1890. Johnny Joestar, a genius jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, chases after outlaw Gyro Zeppeli in a tough cross-continent horse race.

show.name: Reading Bones Identifying Hearts
show.summary: Wrongfully killed, Yan Qing, a brilliant modern-day forensic pathologist, finds herself transported to the turbulent nation of Xin, where she uses her advanced forensic expertise to rewrite her destiny and crosses paths with Shi Ting, a cold and formidable young warlord. Armed with forensic evidence and scientific knowledge, she unravels a series of bizarre murder cases, exposing hidden conspiracies and the corruption of those in power. Guided by a mysterious system's missions, the two gradually evolve from wary allies into partners willing to risk their lives for each other. While challenging outdated conventions and societal prejudices through her pursuit of justice, Yan Qing helps Shi Ting eliminate political rivals, consolidate his power, and ultimately rise to the position of Young Marshal. Amid political intrigue and turbulent times, they fight side by side, seeking justice through criminal investigations and finding redemption in their love. Their journey unfolds into a gripping Republican-era romance filled with suspense, triumphant reversals, heartfelt tenderness, and heart-wrenching struggles.

show.name: The Necromancer! I Am A Disaster
The Necromancer! I Am A Disaster
show.summary: The game has crossed into reality, and the old rules no longer apply. Humanity enters an age where anyone can awaken a class, but the opportunity draws unwanted attention: demons from the abyss and the dragonkin both want this new world, and neither is willing to share it. Lin Moyu wakes up in this world with the one class no one else has: Necromancer. His talent is unmatched, his ability system unlike anything else in play, and he grows stronger with every fight, building an army out of the dead until he no longer needs anyone else at his side. As the Shenxia Empire's last line of defense against the abyssal invasion, he becomes the one man capable of breaking the deadlock between humans, demons, and dragons, and the one who ends up standing above all three.

show.name: Demons' Crest
show.summary: Yuma Ashihara was set to enjoy a test session of Actual Magic (AM)—the world's first fulldive VRMMO-RPG—together with his classmates Sawa Ashihara, Kenji Kondo, and Minagi Sano. The plan was simple: defeat the boss as a party of four, log out, and finish the test play safely — or at least, that's how it was supposed to go.

show.name: My Rival & Me
show.summary: Acclaimed actor Gu Yi Liang and rising star Wei Yan Zi are sworn rivals in the eyes of their fans. But when Wei Yan Zi accidentally discovers a fan community dedicated to shipping the two of them, he becomes hopelessly obsessed. Little does he know that the seemingly aloof Gu Yi Liang has already fallen for him. Believing Wei Yan Zi hates him, Gu can only watch over him from afar.

show.name: Melania Rea
show.summary: This gripping drama series tells the tragic story of Melania Rea, whose case reveals a toxic marriage marked by lies and manipulation.

show.name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
show.summary: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List pairs Alan Carr with his comic friends, including Jack Dee, Tom Allen and Joanne McNally and more, sending them on a mission to road-test the world's most popular bucket list activities. Across the series, our comics try as many experiences as possible - from the classic to the absurd - and debate whether each one deserves to stay on the Bucket List or never be spoken of again.

show.name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
show.summary: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List pairs Alan Carr with his comic friends, including Jack Dee, Tom Allen and Joanne McNally and more, sending them on a mission to road-test the world's most popular bucket list activities. Across the series, our comics try as many experiences as possible - from the classic to the absurd - and debate whether each one deserves to stay on the Bucket List or never be spoken of again.

show.name: Beautiful Malice
show.summary: A girl from Sichuan, Zhang Zhi'an, moves to South Korea to study abroad and stumbles into an elite chaebol academy — landing in Class F, the lowest tier of the social ladder. Here, everyone lives by a strict code of power drawn along lines of birth and family background, and the whole class is steeped in outright malice. But an airhead is the natural antidote to a schemer: armed with her uniquely Chinese brand of relaxed, unbothered obliviousness, Zhang Zhi'an doesn't just fail to sense the hostility around her — she's far too busy wanting to study to care. Then, one day, she lets slip a glimpse of explosive martial-arts skill that floors the entire class. Slowly but surely, in her own distinctly Chinese way, she begins steering the lost, rebellious students of Class F back toward learning — kicking off a fiery, rule-breaking high-school journey in which she climbs step by step through the academy, turning Class F into a name to be reckoned with.

show.summary: The series follows the brutal murder of a pregnant woman, her husband, and her young brother on a dark country road. It exposes the subsequent cover-up, the wall of silence kept by dozens of local witnesses who were bound by a blood oath, and the grueling investigation to bring the killers to justice.

show.name: Infamia
show.summary: Emma Cruz, a lawyer going through a personal crisis, begins investigating the mysterious disappearance of two girls that took place twenty years earlier. The case soon becomes an obsession linked to her own past—a past marked by the death of her sister when they were both young. Her search for answers leads her to uncover the secrets hidden in Ura, a fictional town where some of the inhabitants are determined to prevent the truth from coming to light.

Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama.

Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.

Rapp finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, Carson, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, Katherine, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

show.name: Als de brandweer
show.summary: Traffic accidents and resuscitation, but also elevator confinements, escaped animals and entrapments: the fire brigade does so much more than just extinguish fires. Als de brandweer shows the work of the Dutch fire department and shows what it is like to be in the shoes of these heroes when they head for an incident from a barracks. What starts in the emergency room with a frightened emergency call is given a follow-up if they get into the tanker syringe within one minute and blow out with screaming sirens. Never before have viewers come so close to the fire. They experience everything through the eyes of the firefighters, who portray their work themselves with different cameras.

show.name: Brandweer 010
show.summary: Sirens. Smoke. Fire. Life-saving decisions when every second counts. In a raw and unscripted look behind the uniform, cameras follow the first responders of the Rotterdam-Rijnmond fire brigade as career professionals and volunteers risk everything to navigate high-stakes emergencies, intense high-pressure rescues, and the personal toll of life on the front lines.

show.name: Mujeres Asesinas
show.summary: Stories of eight women who did not live simple, serene or happy lives. They faced violent partners, manipulative parents, hostile bosses, and humiliating situations. They all tried unsuccessfully to improve their lives. Without the resources or psychological help, they reached their limit, and jail or death seemed less frightening than continuing to endure their situation.
